# gyro_project (Resource)

A project groups services in the client area and the API (e.g. one per business, client or environment). Destroying it only deletes the project: its services go back to the default project (id 0). At most 50 projects per account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A project per business / client / environment. Destroying it only deletes the project:
# its services go back to the default project (id 0).
resource "gyro_project" "gyroproje" {
  name        = "Gyro Proje"
  description = "Web + API + CDN"
  color       = "blue"
  icon        = "rocket-takeoff"
}

# New servers and load balancers can be ordered straight into a project.
resource "gyro_server" "web" {
  plan          = "standart-2-4"
  region        = "tr-ist-1"
  image         = "ubuntu-24.04"
  confirm_order = true
  project_id    = tonumber(gyro_project.gyroproje.id)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) 1-40 characters: letter or digit first, then letters, digits, space and . _ - / + # & ( ). Unique per account; Genel/General/Default are reserved.

### Optional

- `color` (String) One of gray, blue, green, red, orange, yellow, purple, pink, teal, indigo.
- `description` (String) Up to 255 characters.
- `icon` (String) Bootstrap Icons name shown in the client area (folder, rocket-takeoff, controller, ...).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Project id.
- `service_count` (Number) Live services in the project (active, suspended, in process, waiting).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import gyro_project.gyroproje 6
```
